infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 April, three new school routes will be introduced to serve the Calderwood catchment and surrounds.

New routes:
  • S269 – Calderwood to St Josephs HS
  • S270 – Calderwood to Albion Park HS
  • S271 – Calderwood to Shellharbour Anglican College
These routes will be operated by Premier Illawarra and will service St Joseph’s Catholic High School, Albion Park High School and Shellharbour Anglican College.
 
Morning AM services
  • S269 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:38 and arrive at St
    Joseph’s at 07:48.
  • S270 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:58 and arrive
    at Albion Park HS at 08:09.
  • S271 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 08:20 and arrive at
    Shellharbour Anglican College at 08:50.
Afternoon PM services
  • S270 – Bus will depart Albion Park HS at 14:40 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 14:50.
  • S269 – Bus will depart St Joseph’s HS at 15:00 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 15:13.
  • S271 – Bus will depart Shellharbour Anglican College at 15:40 arriving at
    Escarpment Drive at 16:17.
Use the Trip Planner to plan your new trip.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.
